item.title: Network Rail to carry out essential maintenance of vital rail corridor this Easter
item.description: Network Rail is advising passengers travelling through the vital rail corridor in the Eastleigh area to plan ahead of travel and to leave plenty of time to reach destinations over the Easter weekend, with warnings of disruption as essential engineering work takes place from Friday, 3 April to Monday, 6 April.

item.title: Bodmin Railway set to celebrate Mother’s & Ladies Day with discounts and afternoon tea
item.description: Bodmin Railway is celebrating Mother’s & Ladies Day in style this Mothering Sunday (15 March 2026).

item.title: Severn Valley Railway offering a special Mother’s Day
item.description: Families looking to treat Mum this Mother’s Day can enjoy a relaxed and memorable day out at the Severn Valley Railway, with a combination of great food and steam travel.

item.title: London trains will be disrupted this Easter
item.description: Passengers are being asked to plan ahead and leave plenty of time for travel between Friday, 3 to Monday, 6 April. Trains between London Waterloo and Clapham Junction will run a reduced service as engineers carry out essential track and bridge work.

item.title: The Llangollen & Corwen Railway to host annual Classic Transport Weekend this summer
item.description: The Llangollen & Corwen Railway has confirmed the return of its popular Classic Transport Weekend on 4-5 July 2026, with vehicle entries now open.

item.title: London Transport Museum set to open Depot to public
item.description: Between 9 and 12 April 2026, the London Transport Museum will open its Depot in Acton Town for a rare behind-the-scenes look at over 320,000 objects from the city’s transport past. This year’s event celebrates big milestones in London transport history, including 120 years of the Bakerloo and Piccadilly lines, and 70 years of the iconic Routemaster bus.

item.title: Great Western Railway launches celebration of folklore with Sir Michael Morpurgo
item.description: Rail operator Great Western Railway (GWR) has launched a campaign to celebrate and preserve regional folklore, marking World Book Day with a new collection of myths and legends from the South West and Wales.

item.title: Harry Styles tribute act to travel on LNER’s special LNER ‘Together, Together’ Train
item.description: A Harry Styles tribute act will be entertaining London North Eastern Railway (LNER) passengers in June, to mark the start of the real Harry Styles' series of concerts at Wembley Stadium in London.
